Given the Cartesian equation x−y+4z+16=0 of the plane Π, find an equation of Π in the form (r−p)⋅n=0.

a
(r−⟨0,0,1⟩)⋅⟨1,−1,4⟩=0
b
(r−⟨0,0,−4⟩)⋅⟨1,−1,4⟩=0
c
(r−⟨0,0,1⟩)⋅⟨−1,−1,16⟩=0
d
(r−⟨0,0,−1⟩)⋅⟨1,0,4⟩=0
e
